cells: - IS 4880 (Parts 1-9) - Code of Practice for Design of Tunnels Conveying Water / general tunnel design guidance
Conceptual design calculations - structural stability, drainage, ventilation & safety
- IS 456:2000 - Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (permissible stresses, section design)
- IRC:SP:91-2019 - Guidelines for Road Tunnels (ventilation, fire & life safety)
- PIARC Technical Committee Reports - Road Tunnel Operations (ventilation & smoke control)
- Terzaghi, K. (1946) - Rock Defects and Loads on Tunnel Supports (loosening pressure theory)
- Einstein, H.H. & Schwartz, C.W. (1979) - Simplified Analysis for Tunnel Supports (elastic ring theory)
- Kennedy, W.D. et al. (1996) - Fundamentals of critical velocity in tunnel fires
- Yellow cells are EDITABLE inputs. All other cells are LIVE FORMULAS - change an input and results recalculate.
- Sheet 'Structural_Lining' - Terzaghi loosening pressure, ring thrust/moment, RCC lining stress & FOS check.
- Sheet 'Ventilation' - CO-dilution fresh-air demand, critical velocity for smoke control, jet fan count.
- Sheet 'Drainage' - groundwater seepage, portal rainfall runoff (Rational Method), pipe sizing, sump/pump.
- These mirror the Python scripts in /python (same method & formulas) for cross-verification.
